FEATURES \n\n \nDouble Wheel\n \nIn the base game, landing one or two Big Bell Scatter symbols can alert the wolf and may trigger the Double Wheel (the wolf’s mood is purely for show, so don’t try to sweet-talk him). The first wheel can award an Instant Prize, trigger the Cashmere Spins Sheep feature, or land on Upgrade – unlocking a second wheel with even bigger Instant Prize segments and more Sheep features.\n\n \n \nInstant Prizes\n \nWhen the wheel points to an Instant Prize segment, it pays immediately – simple, snappy, and wolf-approved (for once).\n\n \n \nSheep Character Features\n \nIf the wheel lands on a Sheep character, you’ll get six re-spins (no retrigger). The Big Bell Scatters that triggered the wheel set up the starting Frames before the re-spins begin, and any Big Bell Scatters that land during the feature transform into that Sheep’s Frames. The three Sheep characters are:\n\n \nCashmere (Hay Frames)\n\n \nWoollyhammer (Wood Frames)\n\n \nBanksie (Gold Frames)\n\n \nFrames only upgrade when the grid is full: Hay upgrades to Wood, and Wood upgrades to Gold. If the reels are completely filled with Gold Frames and another Big Bell Scatter lands, it pays immediately with x100. (Also: Barn Spins can’t be triggered during this feature – the sheep are busy.)\n\n \n \nBarn Spins\n \nLand three or more Big Bell Scatters in the base game to trigger Barn Spins. You start with six Barn Spins, and they can be retriggered by landing three or more Big Bell Scatters again (up to a cap of 80).\n\n \nYour starting Frames depend on how many Big Bell Scatters land when Barn Spins trigger:\n\n \n3 Scatters: 3 Hay Frames\n\n \n4 Scatters: 4 Wood Frames\n\n \n5 Scatters: 5 Gold Frames\n\n \nDuring Barn Spins, the Prize Wheel can also award extra spins (+1, +3, or +5).\n\n \n \nFrames Into Barns\n \nIn Barn Spins, Big Bell Scatters create and upgrade Frames: Hay → Wood → Gold. If a Scatter lands on a Gold Frame, it shifts to help build elsewhere – creating a new Hay Frame in an empty spot or upgrading what’s already there. And if the grid is all Gold Frames, a landing Big Bell Scatter pays immediately with x100.\n\nWhen Barn Spins end, those Frames transform into barns that reveal multiplier prizes. Hay barns can reveal 2x to 5x, Wood barns 6x to 12.5x, and Gold barns 15x to 25x.","inGameArtwork":" IN-GAME ARTWORK \n\nBarn Busters brings the farmyard to life in bold, cartoon colour – bright skies, cosy barns, and enough rustic charm to make the wolf look even more out of place. FEATURES \n \nFeature Pots\n \nAbove the reels sit three pots — BOOST, MYSTERY, and COLLECT. Green, red, and blue Gems fill these pots in the base game and can power up Hold’n Win with their respective enhancements. Enhancements resolve in the order: Mystery, then Boost, then Collect.\n\n \n \nMine Cart Cash Collect\n \nAt random in the base game, one to five Mine Carts may rattle along the track and stop under reels. If a reel above a cart shows any cash Gem values, those values are collected — a tidy sweep before heading back to work. (The carts take a break during Hold’n Win.)\n\n \n \nHold’n Win\n \nEnter the cavern’s core Hold’n Win in three ways: by landing six or more Gem symbols, by filling feature pots through collected Gems, or via a Special Gem that guarantees entry with one, two, or three enhancements. You start with three re-spins; any new Gem resets the counter. When the grid is full, the Grand cash pot is awarded.\n\n \n \nGem Enhancements\n \nBoost (Green Gem): Increases all cash values in view.\n\nMystery (Red Gem): Reveals a higher-tier random value.\n\nCollect (Blue Gem): Gathers all cash values in view.\nYellow Gems carry cash values, and in Hold’n Win they can also award named cash pots.\n\n \n \nCash Pots\n \nMini, Minor, Major, and Grand pots can be awarded in Hold’n Win. FEATURES \n\nIn Tomb of Gold Reimagined, the base game is all about crisp combinations and the kind of golden glare that makes you squint. Then those pots above the reels start filling, and the tomb’s real tricks begin to show.\n\n \n \nMultiplier Wilds\n \nWilds can land in the base game as regular Wilds or Multiplier Wilds with x2 and x3. If more than one Multiplier Wild helps form a win, the multipliers add together, so x2 plus x3 becomes x5.\n\n \n \nThree Gem Pots\n \nAbove the reels sit three pots, each tied to a different coloured Gem Scatter. As matching Scatters land, they’re collected into their pot, and any one, two, or all three pots can be the ones that wake the feature.\n\n \n \nLock’n Gold\n \nWhen a pot triggers, the tomb shifts into Lock’n Gold. The reels clear to Coins only, and any Coins that land stay locked in place while re-spins continue. Coin values stay hidden until they’re revealed, either by the pot features during play or when the feature ends. Re-spins reset whenever one or more Coins land.\n\n \n \nDouble Horus\n \nWhen the blue Double Scatter feature is active during Lock’n Gold, it can flip selected Coins to reveal their values, then double them. The doubled Coin stays visibly marked for the rest of the feature, and a Coin can be doubled more than once.\n\n \n \nSerpent’s Surge\n \nWhen the red Ignite Scatter feature is active during Lock’n Gold, it targets a Coin, flips it to reveal its value, and boosts it. That same Coin continues to gain extra value on subsequent spins while the feature runs.\n\n \n \nBonus of Anubis\n \nWhen the purple Bonus Scatter feature is active during Lock’n Gold, four bonus panels appear above the reels, ranging from Mini up to Grand, each with three spaces to fill. FEATURES \n\n \nMystery Symbols\n \nMystery Symbols can land on any spin, stacking up to hide what’s really going on underneath. When they reveal, they transform into a matching set of symbols across the reels, which can include Regular Symbols, Wilds, Multiplier Wilds, or the Magic Circle.\n\n \n \nWilds and Multiplier Wilds\n \nWilds arrive via Mystery reveals and substitute for most symbols. If Pandora decides to get involved, those Wilds can be upgraded into Multiplier Wilds, with different multiplier values. If more than one Multiplier lands on the same payline, they add together for that line.\n\n \n \nMagic Circle Re-Spin\n \nThe Magic Circle can also be revealed by Mystery Symbols. After wins are evaluated, it summons Pandora as an Expanding Wild and triggers a Re-Spin. That Re-Spin guarantees a fresh set of Mystery Symbols, and if another Magic Circle appears, you can build a Re-Spin streak that upgrades the new Expanding Wild into a Multiplier version, up to x5. Re-Spins are capped at 30.\n\n \n \nSouls and Spirit Orbs\n \nSouls appear attached to Regular Symbols on the reels and play a key role in the game’s Instant Bonus moments. During Free Spins, some Mystery reveals can produce Regular Symbols carrying Spirit Orbs. If Souls are present, Spirit Orbs can activate and award an Instant Bonus, with the value boosted by the number of Souls currently on the reels.\n\n \n \nPandora’s Box\n \nPandora’s Box is an Instant Bonus that can trigger when Souls exist on the reels. The more Souls you collect in a spin, the higher the chance it has to unlock, awarding one of four prize levels.\n\n \n \nFree Spins\n \nLand three, four, or five Scatter Symbols in the base game to trigger Free Spins. Scatters can also retrigger during Free Spins for additional spins.","inGameArtwork":" IN-GAME ARTWORK \n\nThis is myth with a neon pulse. Randomly, this Pirate Progressive Style (PPS) feature can trigger – the ship fires celebratory cannons and stolen royal gold erupts on screen, awarding one of four Jackpots shown beside the reels. If four Coins land, a re-spin gives a second chance to collect the final two Coins, while any single Coin instead feeds into the PPS feature. The outer ring shows potential Free Spin amounts and the inner ring displays multipliers from x1 up to x5. Collect them to charge a Persistent Progression System with four stages: Non-Charged, Slightly Charged, Fairly Charged, and Fully Charged. At any stage, landing these overlays can randomly trigger the Northern Lights Wheel.\n\n \n \nNorthern Lights Wheel – Animal Spirit Trials\n \nWhen the Northern Lights Wheel activates, it illuminates one of five bonus games at random. Footprint Overlay Symbols do not appear during Bonus Games.\n\n \n \nOwl’s Wisdom\n \nThree spins are awarded, with large Owl Symbols appearing as either two 2x2 Owls (on reels one to two and four to five) or one 4x4 Mega Owl (on reels two to five). During each spin, the Owl layout can shift position and may transform between formats.\n\n \n \nSavage Bear\n \nThree spins are awarded. Before each spin, a random multiplier of up to 10 is revealed and applied to any resulting win.\n\n \n \nWolves in the Wild\n \nThree spins are awarded. Wolf Symbols act as Sticky Wilds and substitute for all other symbols. The feature begins with four Sticky Wilds placed randomly, and each time additional Wolf Symbols land, a re-spin is awarded – with new Wolves joining the pack as Sticky Wilds.\n\n \n \nWilderness Reindeer\n \nThree spins are awarded. Reindeer Symbols act as Expanding Wilds and substitute for all other symbols. The feature starts with one Expanding Wild placed randomly, Expanding Wilds move one reel to the left on each spin, and any new Reindeer that land become Expanding Wilds too. Each time additional Reindeer appear, a re-spin is awarded.\n\n \n \nMajestic Fox\n \nA grid of 20 tiles appears. Pick tiles one at a time to reveal hidden prizes – and the Fox might even uncover a way into one of the other Bonus Games. Free Spins can be re-triggered up to a maximum of 80 spins.\n\nGO Collect & Gold Staters\nIn the base game, Gold Staters may appear attached to symbols other than the Tomb Scatter. Each collected Stater fills the GO Collect meter and can help unlock the Treasure Vault feature. Staters don’t appear during Free Spins, keeping the focus there on Expanding Symbol wins.\n\nTreasure Vault (Hold N Spin) & Treasure Gamble\nWhen the Treasure Vault opens, the reels switch to a coin chamber with 3 Re-Spins. Only Staters land here: regular ones with x1–x5 values and Bonus Staters carrying Mini, Minor, Major or Grand tags. Any new Stater resets Re-Spins to 3; when the grid is full or spins run out, all values combine.\n\nAfterwards, the optional Treasure Gamble appears. A single spin of Brilliant and Broken coins decides whether the Vault total is doubled or lost. This can be taken up to four times in succession, letting players choose how bold they want to FEATURES \n\nIn 3 Blades & Blessings, the action centres on three golden chests hovering above the reels. Each one is tied to a different Coin colour and a different style of Free Spins, giving plenty of variety whenever a feature is triggered.\n\n \n \nPerceived Coin Collection\n \nGreen, purple, and red Coins can land anywhere on the reels and are collected into the Collect, Boost, and Bonus Chests above. As more Coins appear, each chest visually grows and changes, hinting that something big is on the way. This perceived persistence has no accumulating value – it’s there to build atmosphere as you play. Whenever enough energy gathers, any of the three chests may randomly trigger its Free Spins feature.\n\n \n \nCollect Free Spins\n \nWhen the green Collect Chest activates, you enter Collect Free Spins with a set of 7 spins. During this feature, special Prize Coin symbols can land on the reels, each displaying an instant prize. Whenever these Prize Coins appear, all visible prizes are collected there and then, creating a fast-paced, collect-as-you-go feel to the round. Collect Free Spins cannot be retriggered, so every spin counts.\n\n \n \nBoost Free Spins\n \nTrigger the purple Boost Chest and the reels expand from the usual layout to a 5x5 grid with 40 paylines for 7 Boost Free Spins. All standard payline wins are doubled during this feature, keeping the focus firmly on line wins across the expanded reel set. Like the Collect feature, Boost Free Spins cannot be retriggered once active.\n\n \n \nBonus Free Spins\n \nWhen the red Bonus Chest opens, you are granted 7 Bonus Free Spins. Here, Bonus Coin symbols can land and reveal different rewards: extra Free Spins or Minor, Major, and Grand Bonus prizes. Revealing “+1 Free Spin” adds an extra spin to your current total, while collecting sets of Minor, Major, or Grand Bonus Coins awards their respective Bonus prizes.\n\n \n \nSuper Free Spins – Two Blessings Combined\n \nSometimes, two chests are triggered together, and that’s where Super Free Spins come in. There are three different Super modes, depending on which blessings merge:\n\n \n \nCollect & Boost Super Free Spins\n \nGreen and purple chests activate at once, awarding 7 Super Free Spins on an expanded 5x5 reel set with 40 paylines. Prize Coins can land, awarding instant prizes that are collected on hit, while all payline wins are doubled.\n\n \n \nBoost & Bonus Super Free Spins\n \nPurple and red chests combine for 7 Free Spins with expanded reels and doubled payline wins. Bonus Coins can land, revealing extra Free Spins or Minor, Major, and Grand Bonus prizes.\n\n \n \nBonus & Collect Super Free Spins\n \nRed and green chests merge for 7 Free Spins. Both Prize Coins and Bonus Coins can appear together, with Prize Coins awarding instant prizes and Bonus Coins granting extra spins or Minor, Major, and Grand Bonus prizes.\n\n \nIn all Super modes, Free Spins themselves cannot be retriggered, so the focus stays on making the most of the spins you have.\n\n \n \nMega Free Spins – All Three Blessings\n \nWhen all three chests – Collect, Boost, and Bonus – are activated at the same time, the ultimate feature is unleashed: Mega Free Spins. You receive 7 Free Spins on a 5x5 reel set with 40 paylines. Both Prize Coins and Bonus Coins can land, with Prize Coins awarding instant prizes as soon as they hit, while Bonus Coins can grant extra spins or Minor, Major, and Grand Bonus prizes.
